bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
original=req_20261128111400ab1c0d0008
candidate=
for p in "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/G-ACE-inc--server-core" "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/g-ace-inc--server-core" "$HOME/Project/Gserver/workspace/server-core" "$HOME/Project/server-core" "$HOME/server-core" "$HOME/Project/Gserver/repository"; do
  if test -f "$p/scripts/servercore_host_output_private_artifact_publish.py"; then candidate="$p"; break; fi
done
if test -z "$candidate"; then
  candidate=$(find "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects" -maxdepth 4 -type f -path '*/scripts/servercore_host_output_private_artifact_publish.py' -print -quit)
  test -n "$candidate" || { printf 'EXISTING_PUBLISHER_NOT_FOUND\n' >&2; exit 74; }
  candidate=$(dirname "$(dirname "$candidate")")
fi
cd "$candidate"
python3 -B scripts/servercore_host_output_private_artifact_publish.py "$original" --writer-ledger --writer-dir "$HOME/.local/state/gserver-terminal/results"
